name: cohortwatch
description: Daily workshop queue that ranks vans by real risk and catches shared outbreaks early.

scripts.sim:reset: docker compose stop simulator && docker compose run --rm simulator node services/simulator/dist/main.js reset && docker compose up -d simulator
scripts.sim:bench: docker compose stop simulator && docker compose run --rm -e SIM_WORKERS=8 simulator node services/simulator/dist/main.js bench --duration 120
scripts.sim:bench:burst: docker compose stop simulator && docker compose run --rm -e SIM_WORKERS=8 simulator node services/simulator/dist/main.js bench --burst
scripts.history:big: docker compose run --rm simulator node services/simulator/dist/main.js history --days 30 --interval-min 2
